name: Parabloom
description: Somebody left a dish pointed at the sky and went home, and it has been listening ever since. Parabloom turns all day after whatever is loudest — a weather balloon, a taxi radio, a song from four towns over — and repeats the best of it to whoever is standing nearest. It has never once kept a secret, and it does not understand why anyone would want it to.
babyDescription: A saucer no wider than a bottle cap on a stub of mast, turning, finding nothing yet.
teenDescription: The dish has opened out and the horn has gone up. Repeats about half of what it hears and is confidently wrong about the rest.
adultDescription: A full dish sweeping the sky all day, reporting everything it finds, in order, to nobody in particular.
